subject_definitions:

<Video 1> is the source video for the target video edit: a three-shot palace comedy clip in which a red-robed bride girl poses in the hall, a purple-robed emperor reacts in shock while a light-blue-robed young man stands behind him near the doorway, and the emperor finally faces the bride in a two-shot.

<Subject 1> is the light-blue-and-white-robed young man in <Video 1>, the character to be removed: long black hair with a silver crown set with blue gems, layered light-blue and white robes with silver cloud embroidery and a tassel pendant.

<Subject 2> is the red-robed bride girl in <Video 1>: an ornate red-and-gold embroidered wedding robe and a red-gold phoenix crown with dangling red tassels.

<Subject 3> is the middle-aged emperor in <Video 1>: black beard, gold crown with a purple gem, purple robe with gold dragon embroidery.

<Audio 1> is the synchronized audio track of <Video 1>, reused in the target video.

summary:

[video editing + audio reuse] The target video is an edited version of <Video 1> in which <Subject 1>, the light-blue-robed young man, is completely removed from every frame and the background behind him is cleanly reconstructed; <Subject 2>'s and <Subject 3>'s performances, the camera movement, the whip-pan, the timing, and the original audio are all preserved.

retention_analysis:

<Video 1> (three-shot structure, camera movement, whip-pan, timing): fully_preserved - shot order, the whip-pan at the end of [Shot 1], the push-in on <Subject 3>, and the original duration are retained.

<Subject 1> (appears in no shot): removed - the light-blue-robed young man does not appear anywhere in the target video; all pixels formerly occupied by him are replaced with a coherent, temporally stable palace background.

<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - red-gold wedding robe, phoenix crown, poses, and dialogue performance retained.

<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - face, beard, crown, purple-gold robe, and his shocked pointing and sweating performance retained.

<Audio 1>: fully_copy - <Audio 1> is reused 1:1 as the target video's complete final audio track.

detailed_description:

The target video keeps the cinematic period-drama look of <Video 1>, with warm daylight, rich red drapery, and gilded palace woodwork, and reproduces its camera work frame for frame, with no trace of <Subject 1> in any shot.

[Shot 1] The red-robed bride <Subject 2> stands smiling at the center of the hall with hands on hips, exactly as in <Video 1>, alone in the symmetrical hall; no other figure is present. The shot ends with the same whip-pan blur.

[Shot 2] At 00:01.000, the shot cuts to <Subject 3> in the left foreground, eyes wide, pointing and sweating in shock, his performance unchanged. The background right by the open latticed door, where <Subject 1> originally stood, is now empty: the doorway, red drapery, lattice windows, hanging lantern, and the carpeted platform are reconstructed as a clean, uninterrupted background with correct perspective and lighting, stable across the whole push-in. The camera repeats the original push-in on <Subject 3>.

[Shot 3] At 00:04.000, the shot cuts to the two-shot of <Subject 3> on the left and <Subject 2> on the right facing each other as she speaks, unchanged; the frame edge that previously showed a sliver of <Subject 1>'s robe is now cleanly filled with the hall background, leaving only the two of them in the composition.

overall_soundscape:

The copied ambience layer from <Audio 1> continues throughout the target video, including footsteps, cloth rustle, dialogue, and hall room tone; no footsteps or rustle attributable to <Subject 1> remain.

non_diegetic_music:

N/A - no new score is added; any original score travels with the fully copied <Audio 1>.
